messages:
Anne: quick check — PR #16205 is ready from my side but CI is flaking. we need to decide whether to push before tomorrow's deploy freeze or hold for the next rebase window. pinging for a quick review and any CI help.

Chris: on it. can you confirm you rebased onto latest main? last time we had a fixture mismatch after rebase.

Anne: yep rebased ~30m ago. local run passed but CI integration times out on the auth tests. snippet below from the job: 
```
ERROR: IntegrationTest::AuthTimeout
  Expected token within 2000ms, got timeout after 5000ms
  at tests/integration/auth_test.go:143
```

Sanjeev: looks like the same flaky timeout we've seen in canary. i'll try a local repro with the increased timeout. if it's purely timing we can mark it flaky or add backoff. prefer not to relax prod assertions unless we see consistent failure.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #573 reported: integration-tests failed (timeout). Full log: https://ci.redwood/573/logs :warning:

Jen: i can take a quick security/ops checklist and +1 if it's just the timeout. if we can't get a stable green before freeze i'd recommend holding — we have rollback risk. :thinking_face:

DevOps Oncall: canary slot available 02:30-03:30 UTC tonight, but APAC maintenance overlaps at 03:00 UTC — not ideal. if you want to sneak it in earlier we'll need to coordinate rollback windows.

Chris: if you're happy to run a targeted rerun (auth tests only) i can eyeball the diff and squash commits to make the merge trivial. that should reduce CI time and flakiness surface.

Anne: thanks. i'll trigger a targeted rerun now and paste the job link. hoping it's just noise. if it's not green in 20m i'll mark this to hold for next rebase window and update the PR description. @Jen if you can be ready to +1 after checklist that'd be great. :pray:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #574 queued: integration-tests (auth-only rerun) — https://ci.redwood/574/queue

Sanjeev: started local repro. if it repros i'll push a tiny stabilization patch and ping for a quick review.

Jen: i'll be online in 15m and can sign off if checks look reasonable.

Anne: posted the rerun link in the PR comments. thanks all — will update after results. :slightly_smiling_face:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #574 started. updates will appear here.
